nereus_alternative.title: Venice is live
nereus_alternative.body: Venice is open for NBA 2K27 on PS5. Start with the free 7-day trial: no card, one per Discord account and one per PC — claim it on the website or with /claim_trial here. After the trial it is 25 dollars a month, cancel any time from the billing portal, and you keep access to the end of the period you already paid for. To buy, sign in with Discord on the website and stay in this server. There is no licence key: your access lives on your Discord account and you unlock the app with a one-time code from the connect page, locked to one PC, with 3 free PC resets. You need a PS5 with a 60 Hz capture card or PS5 Remote Play. Xbox is not supported yet. Install from the downloads channel, follow the setup guide, and open a ticket if anything is missing.

embeds.title: Venice is live
embeds.description: Venice is a shot-timing companion for **NBA 2K27 on PS5**. It watches your capture feed and times the release for you.

fields.name: Start free
fields.value: A **7-day trial**, no card. One per Discord account and one per PC — claim it on [zaeorion.com](https://zaeorion.com/) or with `/claim_trial`.

fields.name: Then $25 / month
fields.value: Cancel any time in the [billing portal](https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/5kQ7sL0Ec4Ya5MfcFsgQE00); access runs to the end of the period you paid for. To buy, sign in with Discord on the website and stay a member of this server.

fields.name: No keys to lose
fields.value: Access is linked to your Discord account. You unlock the app with a one-time code from [zaeorion.com/connect](https://zaeorion.com/connect) — one PC at a time, 3 free PC resets.

fields.name: What you need
fields.value: A PS5 with a **60 Hz capture card** or **PS5 Remote Play**, and a Windows PC. Xbox is not supported yet.
